findings.message: 8 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "YOMSP · terrarium studio" (pill) above "Соберите среду обитания под конкретную з"; "01" above "Собрать террариум"; "02" above "Смотреть каталог"; "Catalog" above "Категории"; "Selection" above "Из каталога"

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "01", "02"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 29 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "YOMSP · terrarium studio", "01", "02", "Террариумы").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✦
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 7 gradient fill(s): section.grain.aurora → radial-gradient(832px 480px at 12% -10%, rgba(10, 74, 68, 0.55), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%), radial-gradient(640px  | div.pointer-events-none.absolute → linear-gradient(in oklab, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0%, rgb(250, 248, 244) 100%) | article.group.relative → radial-gradient(832px 480px at 12% -10%, rgba(10, 74, 68, 0.55), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%), radial-gradient(640px

findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 3 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): section.border-y.border-border 1440px | div.marquee-mask.mb-12 1440px | div.mt-12.flex 1160px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 35 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #faf8f4).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "Каталог" 1.1:1 (#e8f0ec on #faf8f4); "Среды обитания" 1.1:1 (#e8f0ec on #faf8f4); "Конфигуратор" 1.1:1 (#e8f0ec on #faf8f4); "Гиды" 1.1:1 (#e8f0ec on #faf8f4)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 48 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 52.8px (3.7vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.
